name: Susinos del Páramo (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and red in the proportions 2:1:2, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Susinos del Páramo (a castle on red above a wheel on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 22 January 2010 (Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Burgos no. 37 of 24 February 2010); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three horizontal stripes of widths 2-1-2, green above, yellow in the centre and red below, charged at the centre with the arms at 60 per cent of the width.

features.role: Susinos del Páramo arms — castle above a wheel
